source_prompt:
Create one photorealistic image of exactly one adult character.

STABLE CHARACTER IDENTITY — preserve without reinterpretation:
An adult Korean woman character named Harim. Face: refined slightly cat-like face; calm dark-brown eyes with subtly upturned outer corners; defined dark eyebrows; refined straight nose with a clean bridge; small mouth with softly full lips; sharp clean jawline. Hair: long straight dark hair with realistic strand definition. Skin: soft pale skin with realistic texture and soft highlight roll-off. Body: tall-looking, slim, healthy, elegant, and believable; long arms and long legs; shoulders relatively narrow shoulders; torso long neck, slim healthy torso, no visible rib protrusion; bust natural proportion consistent with a slim healthy adult; not exaggerated; waist narrow and clearly defined; pelvis and hips moderately developed hips with a graceful waist-to-hip transition; lower body healthy believable lower-body volume supporting the developed hip line; never skeletal; body hair not established; preserve natural realism and do not invent a conspicuous trait. Preserve one coherent adult identity and anatomically consistent body. Keep pose, expression, outfit, camera, lens, lighting, location, and action as scene variables.

SCENE DELTA — applies only to this generation:
Pose: Sitting gracefully on a plush velvet sofa, legs crossed at the ankles, leaning slightly back with one arm resting on the sofa cushion.
Expression: Calm, subtle, enigmatic smile, eyes looking towards the camera with a soft gaze.
Outfit: A sophisticated, form-fitting black midi-length cocktail dress with a subtle sweetheart neckline and long sleeves. The dress reaches mid-calf, paired with sheer black stockings and elegant black high-heeled pumps.
Camera and framing: Medium full shot, capturing her from the head down to the mid-calf, framing her sitting on the sofa.
Lens and perspective: 50mm prime lens, shallow depth of field to softly blur the background.
Lighting: Warm, ambient indoor lighting from a nearby floor lamp, creating soft highlights on her pale skin and hair.
Location: A luxurious, modern living room with a dark velvet sofa and a minimalist background.
Action: Relaxing on the sofa, posing for a portrait.
Scene styling: Long straight dark hair styled neatly behind her shoulders, minimal jewelry including small silver earrings, natural makeup emphasizing her cat-like eyes.

Maintain one coherent face, one anatomically continuous adult body, one active shot scale, coordinated eyes sharing one target, realistic hands, and a complete plausible outfit covering every visible body region. If this is a waist-up portrait, crop above the hips and crotch; do not extend the frame downward unless lower garments are explicitly visible. Do not let scene variables alter the Stable Character Identity.

Avoid: No other people, no exaggerated bust, no skeletal appearance, no visible rib protrusion, no messy hair, no bright/harsh lighting, no casual/sporty clothing, no bare lower body.
